Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.description: What we collect, who can see it, when we delete it and how to ask us to delete your data.
Privacy.intro: Most people who use this site are students, so we collect only the minimum the club needs.
collect: When you sign in: your e-mail address and name.
Membership application: full name, class, phone number, why you want to join, how you would like to help, answers to that recruitment's extra questions, and your consent.
After you become a member: class, team, volunteer hours and the events you signed up for.
Privacy.notCollected: We don't store IP addresses and use no advertising or tracking cookies. Your browser only keeps the cookies needed to sign in and the colour theme you chose.
Privacy.analytics: We count visits with Cloudflare Web Analytics. It uses no cookies and collects no personal data: it only shows totals such as how many pages were viewed, from which country and on what kind of device.
Privacy.google: When you sign in with Google we only receive your name, e-mail address and profile picture. We never see your password, contacts, files or any other Google data. Sign-in is handled by the Clerk service.
who: Applications and phone numbers are seen only by the club's admins (student leaders and the supervising teacher).
A member's name appears on the site only with their consent. Individual volunteer hours are never shown publicly.
We never sell or share your data. The site runs on Cloudflare (database and images); Clerk handles sign-in.
Privacy.sheets: The club keeps a copy of applications in its own Google Sheet, which only the admins can see.
Privacy.retentionRejected: Applications that were not accepted are deleted automatically {days} days after the recruitment closes.
Privacy.retentionAccount: When you delete your account, your account, applications and event sign-ups are removed and your member record is anonymised. Your hours stay in the club's yearly totals without your name.
Privacy.deleteTitle: Asking us to delete your data
Privacy.deleteMember: Members: open “My page” → “Delete my account” to do it yourself.
Privacy.deleteOthers: Applicants, parents and guardians: send the club a request by e-mail or Instagram and a club admin will delete the account and applications.
Privacy.contactChannels: The site has no contact form. You reach the club by e-mail or Instagram; those messages stay with that service (Gmail, Instagram) and are not stored on this site.
